t: A single learning board with nine modules, a camera, and a microphone.
steps: Find the board on the Tindie listing from innoelement.
Order one board for a trial.
Install the Arduino IDE, ESP-IDF, or Aily Blockly.
Use Windows or macOS for Aily Blockly.
Connect the board with a USB-C cable.
Translate the installation guide for your class.
Run a first tutorial on lights or sensors.
